However, this would be pointless right now unless you want to be bleeding edge on this sort of thing. If gene technology has gotten to the point that they could target medical treatment from your DNA, they'll be able to reconstruct your DNA from whatever chromosomal damage might have occurred, outright replace damaged genes, and toss on a few TTAGGG tandem repeats on the ends of your chromosomes to extend your telomeres.
